fields.name: primary_email
fields.description: Primary email address on the user's account. Sign-in identifier and the address Greenhouse uses for outbound mail; additional verified addresses are not surfaced here. Service accounts (integration/ISU users) have no email and are excluded from this endpoint by default; when included via `show_service_accounts=true`, their `primary_email` is an empty string.

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Free-form job title set on the user's Greenhouse profile (e.g. `Senior Recruiter`). Not synchronized with any HRIS title.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: Id of the staffing agency this user belongs to, when the user is an external agency recruiter rather than an employee of your organization. `null` for in-house users.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Concatenation of `first_name` and `last_name` rendered as a single display string. Provided for convenience; partners that need either component should read `first_name`/`last_name` directly.

fields.name: deactivated
fields.description: Whether the user has been deactivated. Deactivated users cannot sign in or be assigned to new jobs, but their historical activity (notes, scorecards, emails) is preserved. Toggle via `POST /v3/users/{id}/deactivate` and `POST /v3/users/{id}/activate`.

fields.name: site_admin
fields.description: Whether the user holds the Site Admin role. Site admins have unrestricted access to every non-confidential job and to organization-level settings. Demote a site admin to a Basic user with `POST /v3/users/{id}/revoke_permissions`.

fields.name: employee_id
fields.description: Partner-supplied external employee identifier, typically the user's HRIS or payroll id. Free-form string; not unique across organizations and `null` when no employee id has been set.

fields.name: linked_candidate_ids
fields.description: Ids of candidate records linked to this user. Populated when an employee is represented by both a user record (for Greenhouse access) and a candidate record (for past or internal applications).

fields.name: office_ids
fields.description: Ids of the offices this user is assigned to. Used to scope future job permissions and to filter the user list by office. Empty when the user is not pinned to any office.

fields.name: department_ids
fields.description: Ids of the departments this user is assigned to. Used to scope future job permissions and to filter the user list by department. Empty when the user is not pinned to any department.

fields.name: interviewer_tags
fields.description: Interviewer tags applied to this user — the labeled skill or panel groupings (e.g. `Senior Engineer`, `Bar Raiser`) used to suggest qualified interviewers when building an interview plan. Each entry pairs the tag's `id` with its `name`.

fields.name: emails
fields.description: All email addresses on the user's account, including the primary address and any additional verified addresses.
